description: Record a manual charge or a manual credit on one apartment. A charge behaves like an open charge: it consumes credit first, then appears as overdue or due soon by its date and is paid by normal payments. A manual credit is a positive correction.

date.description: Due date of the charge. Defaults to today.

type.description: MANUAL_CHARGE adds a debit, MANUAL_CREDIT adds a positive adjustment. Defaults to MANUAL_CHARGE.

name: record_apartment_charge
title: Record apartment charge
